steps.what: the level L(d) := |A(d)| is well-defined, path-independent, an integer (THE HEART)
steps.why: the reconstruction's heart, and where the dcpo floor's real-analysis machinery is NOT needed. WELL-DEFINEDNESS: all 24 propagation orders of a 4-archon element yield the same level 4 and the same set -- the level does not depend on the build order. This is the triadic analog of 'dimension is well-defined' (all maximal orthogonal families have equal cardinality), which is exactly what R13 + R14 + R10b bought on the dcpo floor. COVERING-COLD: a fresh archon raises the level by exactly 1 (01.3's positive disjoint residual), while re-adding a present archon does not -- so the covering property holds and needs disjointness. INTEGRALITY: L(d) is a CARDINALITY, a non-negative integer BY CONSTRUCTION. The dcpo LI had to force a real Scott-continuous measure I onto integer multiples of alpha; the triadic floor never introduced the continuum, so integrality is free. 'No element has a fractional level' becomes 'the level is a count' -- the framework's 'rho is a forced COUNT, no continuum, no free cutoff' thesis, made rigorous.

steps.check: orthogonal levels add (disjoint union); overlapping levels do not (checked negative)
steps.determines: UNIQUE (additivity holds exactly on orthogonal pairs)
steps.expr: for disjoint-residual a, b: |A(a) union A(b)| = |A(a)| + |A(b)|; for overlapping a, b it FAILS -- so additivity is exactly the orthogonal case (R10b/R14 on the dcpo floor)
steps.what: additivity L(a (+) b) = L(a) + L(b) on ORTHOGONAL a, b (overlap = checked negative)
steps.why: the triadic recovery of R10b (valuation: I(a join b) = I(a) + I(b) for orthogonal a, b) and R14 (countable additivity over orthogonal families). Here it is pure cardinality of a DISJOINT union: two orthogonal registration elements (disjoint archon sets -- their residuals do not overlap, 01.3) compose with levels that ADD. The overlapping case is kept as a CHECKED NEGATIVE (the protocol's discipline): elements sharing an archon do NOT add (|{1,2,3} union {3,4}| = 4, not 5) -- so additivity is not vacuous; it holds PRECISELY on orthogonal pairs, which is what the dcpo valuation axiom also restricts to. This is the additivity leg the convergence condition (container 22, CV.2) needs, now cold on the triadic floor.
